device_entry.name: MSO-X 混合信号示波器
tags: 瞬态信号采集与同步触发测量
device_entry.description: 台式混合信号示波器，用于采集和显示电路中的模拟与数字时域信号。常用于电子实验中的波形观察、时序分析、信号完整性检查，以及电压、频率、脉宽等参数的自动测量与统计。
device_entry.description_en: A bench-top mixed signal oscilloscope used to acquire and display analog and digital time-domain signals in electronic circuits. It is commonly used in laboratories for waveform observation, timing analysis, signal integrity checks, and automatic measurement/statistics of parameters such as voltage, frequency, and pulse width.

schema.description: 执行当前波形的自动测量统计。
schema.description_en: Run automatic measurement statistics on the current waveform(s).
